# Third-Party Skill Categories

This directory contains reviewed, documentation-only skill bundles organized by
the work they support. Source bundles remain intact within each category so
their relative Markdown references and license notices remain valid.

| Category | Focus |
| --- | --- |
| `kubernetes/` | Kubernetes, OpenShift, cluster operations, manifests, Helm, and platform troubleshooting |
| `docker/` | Docker containers and local container workflows |
| `observability/` | Metrics, logs, traces, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and OpenTelemetry |
| `argocd-cicd/` | Argo CD, GitOps, deployment pipelines, and CI/CD |
| `devops/` | General DevOps, infrastructure automation, delivery, and technical documentation |
| `sre/` | Incident response, reliability, and infrastructure coordination |
| `shell/` | Shell scripting, prompt configuration, and shell quality checks |
| `agent-platform/` | Hermes-oriented agent, memory, and workflow guidance |

Skill commands keep a `third-party-` prefix to avoid colliding with the
example's built-in skills. The prefix does not grant additional tools or
permissions.
